name: Advertising
summary: Advertising prepares students to create and manage campaigns that persuade audiences to buy products, support causes, or change behaviors. The major combines creativity, strategy, and research.
description: Advertising majors study advertising principles, consumer behavior, copywriting, art direction, media planning and buying, account management, advertising research, digital and social advertising, and campaign strategy. Students often choose a track in creative, strategy, account management, or media. They build full campaigns for real or simulated clients, often in student-run agencies, and many compete in national competitions. Portfolios are essential for creative roles. Graduates work in advertising agencies, in-house marketing teams, media companies, and digital platforms.
